announcements.title: Development Resumed — 1.0.59
announcements.message:
NanaPlay is back! Version 1.0.59 brings a big bug-fix batch: your display name no longer leaks into diagnostics, the Indonesian language option actually works now, local music playlists survive app restarts, stream reconnects are more reliable, and music keeps playing in the background with lock-screen controls. Update from the Settings page. Happy gaming!

NanaPlay kembali! Versi 1.0.59 membawa banyak perbaikan bug: nama tampilan tidak lagi bocor ke diagnostics, opsi Bahasa Indonesia sekarang benar-benar berfungsi, playlist musik lokal tidak hilang saat aplikasi dibuka ulang, reconnect stream lebih andal, dan musik tetap jalan di background dengan kontrol lock-screen. Update dari halaman Settings. Selamat bermain!
